dataset: OS NGD Building Features — free sample data
evidence_slice: Ordnance Survey's official OS Data Hub sample catalogue lists OS Building Features as Free Sample Data covering Exeter, Inverness and Newport, supplied as vector CSV and GeoPackage, version September 2025. The selected source window is the Exeter OS Building Features sample distribution. The indexed catalogue was readable, but reopening the source window returned a cache miss and no downloadable package object or record-level feature payload could be read. No building footprint geometry or record-bound use/description attribute was inferred.

field_evidence.footprint: The selected product is OS Building Features sample data for Exeter, supplied as vector GeoPackage/CSV; no record payload was readable in this window.
field_evidence.type_use: No record-level Building Use/Description value was read because the sample package object was not dereferenceable in the available retrieval channel.
field_evidence.source_scope: Official OS Data Hub free sample catalogue entry for OS Building Features covering Exeter; source-area metadata only.
